note: APAP only, as before: Banreservas answered 403, Banco Popular Dominicano's site sits behind Incapsula, and BHD's site loads its pages by script and gives no tariff to a plain request; APAP's own tariff page lists its documents by script too, so only the Familiar card's tariff, already known, could be read. Asociación Popular de Ahorros y Préstamos' tariff for its Tarjeta de Crédito Familiar (7 October 2026), read in full: the card's 7,500-peso issue charge is applied yearly over the card's life, 2,500 pesos a year (the renewal the same); purchases and cash advances in pesos bear 60% a year; a cash advance (and a casino, crypto, currency or app transfer charge) costs 6.25%; a late payment on a peso balance costs 1,200 pesos and going over the limit 800. The optional insurance and the Cuotas Más Límite instalment line on the same card aren't written. No minimum payment, grace period or foreign transaction fee is stated.
